A '''Mineral Baron''' was a rich and powerful individual involved in resource mining.<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Panatha]] had mineral barons; notably [[Yun's father]] was an extremely prosperous [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]] before his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hand of his son and the seizure of his assets.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050512b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 3: Pride of the Dark Side}}</ref>
